# Site Debug Records — Ops Runbook
_This file is the canonical reference for every site issue, its root cause, fix applied, and prevention pattern._

## [2026-05-18] ev-charging-asia — New blog posts return 404

**Symptom:** `/blog/<new-post-slug>` returns 404 despite data files existing in `data/blog/` and `blog-index.json` being updated.

**Root cause:** The site uses ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration — `revalidate: 3600`). New blog posts are generated by creating JSON files in `data/blog/` and running `scripts/generate-blog-data-node.js` to update `lib/generated-blog-data.ts`. A new Vercel deployment is REQUIRED after new posts are added — ISR only revalidates existing pages, it does NOT create new pages for new slugs.

**Fix applied:**
- `npm run build` passed locally (0 errors, 136 static pages)
- Need to run `npx vercel --prod --yes` to push the build with the new content to production
- (Fix status: ✅ Deployed. All 5 new posts verified returning 200.)

**Prevention pattern:**
- After creating new blog posts → MUST run blog-data generation + redeploy
- Add to SOP: "Verify the new post URL returns 200 after deploy"
- Blog generation & deploy should be a single sub-agent task, not split

**Add to checklist:**
- [ ] Create post JSON files
- [ ] Run `npm run generate-blog-data` (updates `lib/generated-blog-data.ts`)
- [ ] Run `npm run build` (verify 0 errors)
- [ ] Run `npx vercel --prod --yes` (deploy)
- [ ] Verify `https://ev-charging-asia.vercel.app/blog/<slug>` returns 200

## [2026-05-16] family-travel-directory — Blank page on initial deploy

**Symptom:** Home page rendered blank / Application error on Vercel.

**Root cause:** Missing or incompatible `@supabase/ssr` dependency causing server-side rendering failure. The app used Supabase SSR helpers that weren't compatible with Vercel's serverless runtime.

**Fix applied:** Replaced `@supabase/ssr` with direct Supabase client initialization, removed SSR-specific code, redeployed.

**Prevention pattern:** Test `npm run build` before any deploy. If using Supabase, verify SSR compatibility with Vercel serverless before merging.

---

## [2026-05-14] luxury-family-travel — Wrong Vercel app deployed

**Symptom:** Deployments to luxury-family-travel.vercel.app showed ev-charging-asia content.

**Root cause:** Vercel project linked to wrong Git repository. The deployment was pushing to the wrong Vercel project.

**Fix applied:** Re-linked Vercel project to correct GitHub repo via `npx vercel link`.

**Prevention pattern:** After first deploy of any new project, verify the Vercel dashboard shows the correct project name and repo link. Run `npx vercel ls` to confirm project list before multi-project deployments.
